subject: Social Media
title: Influencer Grief
description: A short lesson to help you apply Influencer Grief.

hook.text: When a YouTuber died, fans mourned as deeply as for a family member. Therapists were stunned.

buildup.text: Parasocial grief is real grief. The brain processed the relationship as genuine, so the loss is genuine.

discovery.text: Research shows parasocial grief triggers the same brain regions as mourning a real friend.

twist.text: Society dismisses it. 'You didn't even know them.' But the emotional bond was neurologically real.

climax.text: Therapists now treat parasocial grief as valid. The relationship was one-sided, but the pain isn't.

punchline.text: You don't need to be known to be mourned.

quiz.question: How do therapists now view parasocial grief?
options: As valid grief that mirrors real loss
As a social media addiction symptom
